sketches.intent: Nitride interpretation of a warm pitched wooden mallet: stable pitch, brief harmonic index strike and quick damping, not a sampled marimba or physical model. Contrast Hollow Bronze ringing and Skin's pitch drop.

Nitride interpretation of compact dry sustained organ keys: even amplitude, stable harmonic carrier/operator blend, no cyclic motion or long ambience. Not a drawbar/tonewheel emulation. Contrast articulated Reed Snap.

Nitride interpretation of harmonic FM brass: poly stabs and held swells, rising index/Tone entrance settling to solid body, small network color. Not an acoustic brass model or copied DX algorithm. Contrast mono Glass Current.

Nitride interpretation of dry classic FM slap/rubber bass: short bright index pop, clear settled fundamental and concise stops; no glide, Autobend, cyclic wobble or Space. Must earn distinct utility against Crooked Velvet, not an exact classic preset clone.
